youtube.title: 網址小鎖頭竟然會騙人？幾乎所有釣魚站都有 HTTPS｜原來如此事務所
youtube.description:
網址旁有小鎖頭跟 HTTPS 就能放心打密碼？其實只有 11% 的受試者真正懂小鎖頭的意思，幾乎所有釣魚網站也都掛著 HTTPS，連 Chrome 都在 2023 年宣布把鎖頭換成中性圖示！
用「上課傳紙條」一次看懂網址多一個 S（HTTPS / TLS 1.3）在路上替你的密碼做了什麼：憑證鏈與內建根憑證、公開透明帳本（CT）、眾目睽睽下調顏料交換金鑰與前向保密、防篡改封條與隱藏序號、0-RTT 搶先送出例外，以及信封厚度、網站名稱（SNI / 2026 ECH）與釣魚網站的邊界——為什麼打密碼前一定要自己看清楚網址列！

📚 參考規格與官方出處：
- IETF RFC 8446（TLS 1.3）：https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8446
- IETF RFC 9849（TLS Encrypted Client Hello, 2026-03）：https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9849
- IETF RFC 5280（X.509 PKI Certificate）：https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5280
- IETF RFC 9110（HTTP Semantics）：https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110
- Let's Encrypt How It Works & Chains of Trust：https://letsencrypt.org/how-it-works/
- Certificate Transparency：https://certificate.transparency.dev/howctworks/
- Chromium Blog (2023-05-02) An Update on the Lock Icon：https://blog.chromium.org/2023/05/an-update-on-lock-icon.html
- Google Chrome Support (Check if a site's connection is secure)：https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95617?hl=en
- MDN Web Docs (HTTPS & How the Internet works)：https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/HTTPS

#原來如此事務所 #HTTPS #小鎖頭 #釣魚網站 #網路安全 #TLS #資安科普

lines.text: 因為他們的研究發現，受試者裡竟然只有百分之十一真正懂這顆小鎖頭的準確意思。

lines.speaker: chief

scenes.chapter: 你的密碼根本不是直接飛到網站

data.prompt: Medium shot by the sunny cafe window with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tapping a plain pale-grey tablet on the wooden table with a curious confident expression.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 等等，我現在就在咖啡店用免費網路登入遊戲——密碼不是按下送出就直接飛到遊戲公司嗎？

data.prompt: Wide shot atmospheric cutaway diorama of a bright cafe shelf with a sleek white Wi-Fi router beaming a glowing golden folded paper note along blue relay cables across three distant internet router towers.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 完全不是！你的密碼得先經過咖啡店的無線網路機器、再進網路公司，一站轉一站送去對面。

data.prompt: Wide shot sunlit wooden classroom rows of empty desks with a tiny unfolded cream paper note drifting smoothly across four wooden desks from back row toward the sunlit front desk, zero people.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 就像上課傳紙條給教室另一頭的好朋友，一路上得經過好幾排不認識的同學接手傳過去。

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic still life on a wooden desk: an unsealed open cream postcard glowing faintly with abstract geometric key symbols while a dark magnifying glass hovers above and a coral pencil tip hovers nearby.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 要是沒加密直接傳，路上任何經手的機器不只可能偷看你的密碼，甚至還能偷改裡面的字！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright cafe with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tilting her head innocently with both five-fingered hands raised in a light shrug.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 可是大部分幫忙轉送的機器應該都很好心吧，哪會每一站都把我的密碼拆開來看？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, leaning forward seriously behind her desk with one five-fingered hand gesturing toward a chess-like relay map.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 問題是你沒辦法挑誰幫你傳！所以網路安全規格從一開始，就假設路上有人完全控制網路。

data.prompt: Close-up macro on a warm oak tabletop: a crisp cream envelope sealed tightly with a gleaming crimson wax stamp glowing soft golden aura, opaque luminous protective shell wrapping the envelope.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 多出的 S 代表安全，瀏覽器用叫 TLS 的加密規則把紙條鎖進信封，只有你跟對方網站看得懂。
lines.say: 多出的 S 代表安全，瀏覽器用叫 T L S 的加密規則把紙條鎖進信封，只有你跟對方網站看得懂。

scenes.chapter: 封起來就安全？幾乎所有釣魚站都有鎖頭

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the bright office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, grinning proudly while holding a neatly red-wax-sealed cream envelope in both five-fingered hands.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來如此！那只要把紙條封進信封裡不讓同學拆看，我的密碼就徹底安全了吧？

data.prompt: Wide shot atmospheric miniature street crossroad at dusk: a small cream signpost splitting toward a sunlit blue game castle on left and a shadowy decoy cardboard facade on right, a mischievous masked hand rotating the wooden arrow.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 只封信還不夠！打完網址，電腦得先像查電話簿般問路「這站住哪」——萬一壞人報假地址冒充呢？

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic tabletop scene: a perfectly sealed red-wax cream envelope sliding smoothly straight into a shadowy dark-gloved decoy mailbox with a grinning paper mask taped on front.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 信封封得再緊，親手寄給冒牌貨照樣完蛋！所以寄信之前，對方必須先亮出一張「憑證」。

data.prompt: Close-up editorial illustration on a warm oak tabletop: a crisp cream laminated ID card displaying only a tiny minimalist golden castle emblem and an embossed circular golden wax seal pattern beside a gleaming brass stamp, strictly zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 憑證就像官方證件：寫著網址名字，並留有公開印章樣本，只有握有真私章的本尊才對得上。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, squinting playfully while holding up a hand-drawn crayon doodle card with five clean fingers.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 那這張證件不能自己拿紙畫一張來騙人嗎？瀏覽器怎麼知道誰發的才算數？

data.prompt: Wide shot miniature world globe tabletop diorama: a tiny cream website kiosk sitting in the center with an open golden drawer holding a glowing verification token, while four luminous emerald beams check it simultaneously from different sides of the globe.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 自己畫的憑證瀏覽器不收！得向瀏覽器信任的發證機構申請，它會叫你在網站放指定暗號。

data.prompt: Close-up macro on a clean lab desk: a gleaming brass certification stamper pressing a crisp emerald seal onto a blank card beside a tiny toy house roof, ignoring a dark shadow mask sitting untouched off to the side.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 機構從多處網路同時確認你管得了這網址就發證——但重點來了，它完全不查對方是不是好人！

data.prompt: Medium close-up in the cafe with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, staring down wide-eyed in sudden alarm at a plain pale-grey tablet glowing with a sparkling purple gem icon and tiny green padlock.

lines.text: 等等！同學剛傳來「送免費寶石」的連結，網址開頭竟也掛著 HTTPS 跟小鎖頭耶！
lines.say: 等等！同學剛傳來「送免費寶石」的連結，網址開頭竟也掛著 H T T P S 跟小鎖頭耶！

data.prompt: Close-up side-by-side comparison on a daylight-grey desk: left gleaming sapphire game castle holding a green-sealed badge; right nearly identical crooked cardboard castle with one extra turret holding the exact same green-sealed badge.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 小心，這種免費寶石連結很可能就是釣魚網站！騙子替相似假網址一樣領得到合法憑證。

data.prompt: Close-up wordless UI metaphor on a warm desk: a glowing emerald miniature padlock on the left softly dissolving along golden light particles into two clean neutral horizontal slider-dot toggles on the right.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 鎖頭只代表連線加密，不代表可信，Chrome 二零二三年才換掉它——但更致命的風險還在後頭！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, resting one chin on her five-fingered palm with raised skeptical eyebrows.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 比釣魚站還致命？可發證機構不是只認網址嗎，真銀行的網址騙子又管不到！

data.prompt: Close-up sculptural diorama on a sunny wooden desk: three translucent frosted glass cards arranged like ascending steps—bottom website card stamped by middle intermediate card, stamped by a radiant solid-gold top root card locked inside a tiny glass vault.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 萬一被信任的發證機構自己出包亂發，連真銀行都能被冒充——網址全對，還照樣亮合法鎖頭！

data.prompt: Wide shot sunlit corridor inside a crystal glass archive hall: rows of glowing cream certificate cards sealed forever inside transparent glass display cases where floating golden telescopes inspect them openly.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 所以像 Chrome 跟 Safari 要求每張憑證都登進公開透明帳本，誰都能查，機構一亂發立刻抓包！

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic tabletop scene: a plain sleek glass screen flashing a bold crimson warning triangle icon with a broken silver chain emblem above three tiny silhouettes—a server box, a router, and a tablet, strictly zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 一旦憑證跟網址不符、或沒進公開帳本，瀏覽器立刻整頁亮紅燈擋下——可就算證件全真，還有個看似無解的難題！

scenes.chapter: 大家都在看，怎麼調出只有彼此懂的密碼？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, leaning forward eagerly over the oak desk with both five-fingered palms open in curiosity.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 什麼難題？等等——身分是靠憑證把關了，可鎖信封總得有把鑰匙吧，大家一路都在看，兩邊怎麼約好鑰匙不被偷學？

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling warmly behind her desk where three clean glass paint jars of bright yellow, crimson, and cobalt sit ready.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這靠的是超酷的數學魔術！我們用「調顏料」來想像，兩邊怎麼在眾目睽睽下湊出同一把秘密鑰匙。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 兩人先公開講好同一杯黃色底漆，再各自偷偷滴進只有自己知道的紅顏料跟藍顏料。

data.prompt: Close-up dynamic tabletop composition: a beaker of vibrant tangerine-orange paint gliding right and a beaker of lush emerald-green paint gliding left across a wooden desk while magnifying glasses watch from above.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 接著把混好的橘跟綠交給同學傳——關鍵在顏料一混勻就拆不回原色，偷看也推不出秘方！

data.prompt: Close-up radiant tabletop reveal: both left and right glass beakers now swirl with the exact same rich luminous espresso-gold secret color glowing warmly, while the watchful glass lens in the middle stays empty and puzzled.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 收到對方那杯再補上自己的秘密顏色，兩邊竟調出同一杯深棕色，路上同學卻完全湊不出來！

data.prompt: Close-up luminous artistic cutaway: swirling abstract golden geometric polyhedra locking tightly around a cream sealed envelope inside a shimmering opaque crystal cocoon.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 調顏料只是比喻，實際靠的是數學；這把臨時鑰匙一算好，才把你的紙條跟密碼鎖進信封送出！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, squinting sharply like a tiny detective holding an old wooden cassette recorder prop with five clean fingers.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 等等，前面說網站一直握著真私章——要是壞人把今天鎖進信封的內容全錄下來，以後偷走私章，能一口氣全解開嗎？

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic studio macro: a glass beaker of glowing espresso-gold secret paint evaporating cleanly into sparkling golden mist over a sink right as a fresh crystal timer resets, leaving zero drops behind.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 解不開！真私章只驗身分，這回調出來鎖信的臨時鑰匙用完就銷毀、下次重調，這叫「前向保密」。

data.prompt: Close-up atmospheric night tabletop: a shadowy hand holding a stolen golden brass stamp trying in vain against a row of tightly sealed glowing crystal vaults from earlier days that remain completely shut.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 只要當初的臨時秘密已刪除，就算多年後網站私章被盜，以前被錄下的密文依然只是亂碼。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, eyes lighting up with a clever catch, pointing one clean finger upward.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 等一下！剛說每張憑證都登在公開帳本上——壞人影印遊戲公司憑證、再跟我調顏色怎麼辦？

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic tabletop scene: a heavy ornate golden brass seal pressing directly onto a continuous cream ribbon binding together paint drops, handshake notes, and the glowing badge in one unbroken crimson wax crest.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 影印的人沒有那顆真私章！網站必須當場把真私章蓋在整段開場對暗號、連同顏色的紀錄上。

data.prompt: Close-up split visual on a daylight-grey desk: two matching golden wax-stamped checksum rings clicking together with a bright mint spark on left, while a single mismatched tooth snaps a glowing wire shut on right.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這段開場驗證叫「握手」；雙方最後再對一次整段握手的帳，差半點就斷線，全對上才寄信。

data.prompt: Close-up macro on a warm oak tabletop: a thick cream envelope wrapped in a shimmering golden tamper-proof band extending right across a tiny brass ruler gauge on the front, sparking red where a dark needle tries to poke.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 每封信都用這秘密封好，連信封外的長度都算進封條；半路改一字就打不開、直接斷線。

data.prompt: Medium shot in the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tapping her cheek mischievously holding two identical red-wax-sealed envelopes side by side with five clean fingers.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 改不掉內容的話，壞人把整封加密信原封不動抄下來，偷偷多寄一次或調換前後順序呢？

data.prompt: Close-up intricate cutaway diorama on a light lab desk: a gleaming row of wax-sealed cream envelopes gliding smoothly along two parallel brass gear tracks, glowing hidden gear teeth meshing inside each wax seal while exterior stays blank.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 兩個方向都各自從零幫每封信編號，還把編號藏進封條不寫外面——重送或換順序全都會解密失敗！

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic kinetic shot on a sunlit wooden desk: one impatient cream envelope darting forward ahead of a glowing handshake gate, casting a faint double-echo coral ghost trail behind it.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 但有個規格用「重要提醒」標出的例外：以前連過時，為了省一次來回，第一封信能搶先送出。

data.prompt: Close-up editorial metaphor on a warm tabletop: two identical tiny golden shopping-bag tokens sliding toward a gleaming brass vault gate where a glowing sapphire mechanical stopper arm blocks the duplicate.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這種搶先資料不保證跨連線不被重送，可能害購買重複，規格另寫方法由伺服器自限。

data.prompt: Close-up warm sunlit wooden desk: a final cream envelope stamped with a neat glowing turquoise period-dot wax seal sitting calmly beside a clean pair of brass scissors halted mid-air.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 就連收尾也很講究：寄完得正式發一聲「我講完了」，萬一半路被人剪斷連線才分得出來沒寄完。

lines.text: 還看得到關鍵線索！還記得剛提過信封外標著長度嗎？信有多厚、隔多久寄一封，路上依然看得見。

lines.text: 規格直接提醒：看長度和時間的流量分析有時能猜出資訊，尤其像片庫固定的影片網站特別容易。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 雖然兩邊能塞進空白把信封撐成一樣厚來干擾分析，但到底該塞多少，規格並沒有硬性規定。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 更明顯的線索是要找哪個網站的名字——在連線最開頭，它常常明晃晃寫在信封外頭！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 二零二六年三月發布的網際網路新加密規格，正是想把網站名字裝進裡面一層信封一起封住。

lines.speaker: chief
